game.name: Runescape: Dragonwilds
game.rules:
**In addition to any Game and Category Rules, all Runescape: Dragonwilds runs are subject to all Speedrun.com Site Rules, found [here](https://www.speedrun.com/support/learn/site-rules).**

**Video Requirements:**

- All submissions requires a full video of the run, including game audio.
- Game audio must be audible.
- The video link MUST embed on the run page (e.g. no URL shorteners or sketchy file sharing sites)
- VODs should persist indefinitely (e.g. Highlight instead of Past Broadcast)
- Dynamic HUD elements should not be obscured or omitted (e.g. health, inventory, stamina)

# **Good Faith Submissions**

Runs are expected to be performed in good faith and may be rejected based on mod discretion if performed otherwise. Examples include, but are not limited to: extended stalling to achieve a specific time; intentionally attempting to get the last place time on the leaderboard and/or the longest time possible; or attempting to exploit technicalities in the written category rules in a manner contrary to the spirit of the category. This means that long runs and/or runs with breaks will be considered in good faith so long as effort is still being made.

categories.name: Dragon Slayer
categories.rules:
Must have a full, unedited video of the run. Audio is required.

Timer initially starts at first input. (Looking around with the camera before the timer starts is allowed)

Timer ends when the Primary Quest, "Dragon Slayer" is complete. This is done by summoning and defeating Velgar and bringing Velgar's head to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead village.

categories.name: Secondary Quests
categories.rules:
Must have a full, unedited video of the run. Audio is required.

Must show character/world creation.

For multiplayer speedruns, all players perspectives must be fully recorded individually.

Timer initially starts at first input. (Looking around with the camera before the timer starts is allowed)

Timer ends when the specific secondary quest is complete.

categories.name: Agility Course
categories.rules:
**Agility Course Speedrunning**

**Any% Rules**

All tricks and glitches allowed. (Building preparation, auto run start, clipping through objects, ect.)

**Glitchless Rules**

The categories in this ruleset are meant to be played like an optimized casual playthrough.

Using potions, food/water, and spells is **ALLOWED.**

The following glitches and techniques are **NOT ALLOWED** in Glitchless Agility course speedruns.

- Clipping
- Auto Run Start (Must start standing still)
- Creating any persistent, solid, player-generated object. (Constructions, totems, etc.)

Moderators may deny a run that uses any glitches and techniques not listed above at their discretion, and amend the ruleset to include such glitches/techniques.

categories.name: Raid
categories.rules:
**Raid Speedrun Timing**

Timer starts the first frame the loading icon disappears going into the raid.

Timer ends on the frame the screen goes black after the "Get out now!" timer ends after defeating Kuldra's Heart.
